battle.name: 靈寶之戰
battle.brief: 天寶十五載六月，哥舒翰領唐軍出潼關，進至河南靈寶西南的七十里山道，被崔乾祐的伏兵擊潰，潼關與長安相繼淪陷。卡面的羅馬方陣盾本非唐軍裝備，它代表的是以盾牆抵住騎兵衝鋒的防線觀念；靈寶的官軍並無此制，潰敗渡河時只能把盾綁在矛桿上充作浮具。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 靈寶之戰（756年）爆發在天寶十五載，是安史之亂中唐廷與叛軍在河南、陝西交界的一次總交鋒。交戰的一方是唐朝朝廷：玄宗以哥舒翰為天下兵馬副元帥，節制關中二十萬大軍據守潼關，京師宿衛的龍武軍精騎、關中團練、各道新募之兵與劍南、隴右、河東各鎮的援軍分屯沿線，宰相楊國忠以節制之權居中樞紐。另一方是安祿山建立的燕軍：主力是范陽、平盧、河朔三鎮的契丹、奚、靺靼等部族騎兵與漢軍，崔乾祐以陝郡為基地，奉安慶緒之命經營關中東門。這不是兩支對等的軍隊去爭一個據點，而是一個王朝的中央武裝與一批叛軍在關門前的一次總決戰：朝廷握有編制完整、號令統一但指揮互相掣肘的正規軍，叛軍則靠騎兵機動與內應者的地形知識。第三方是尚未直接捲入的吐蕃與北方諸部，以及在關中、河洛之間被徵發的團練與鄉兵。戰局亦牽動朝廷內部的三股力量：玄宗本人、宰相楊國忠，以及潼關前線的將領集團；誰能決定出不出關、誰的話才算數，才是這場戰爭真正的勝負所在。
countriesEn: The Battle of Lingbao (756 CE) took place in the fifteenth year of Tianbao and was the general engagement between the Tang court and the rebels on the border of Henan and Shaanxi during the An Lushan Rebellion. One side was the Tang court: Emperor Xuanzong appointed Geshu Han as deputy commander-in-chief of all the imperial armies (tiānxià bīngmǎ fùyuánshuài), holding some 200,000 troops at Tong Pass, with the elite cavalry of the Longwu Army, the local militia of the Guanzhong region, newly raised troops from the various circuits, and the reinforcing columns from Jiannan, Longyou and Hedong all deployed along the line, while the chancellor Yang Guozhong sat at the centre of the machine with the authority to direct them. The other side was the Yan army of An Lushan: its core was the cavalry of the Fanyang, Pinglu and Hebei regions, among them Khitan, Xi and Mohe horsemen together with Han troops, and Cui Qianyou based himself at Shaan Commandery on the orders of An Qingxu to work on the eastern gate of Guanzhong. This was not two evenly matched armies fighting over a single strongpoint, but one attempt at a general decision between the centralised armed forces of a dynasty and a body of rebels in front of a pass: the court held a regular army with complete organisation and uniform command, though its command was crippled by mutual checks, while the rebels relied on mounted mobility and on one traitor's knowledge of the ground. Third parties were the Tibetans and the northern tribes, who had not yet entered the fight directly, together with the militia and levies called up in Guanzhong and Heluo. The outcome was also bound up with three forces inside the court itself: Emperor Xuanzong, the chancellor Yang Guozhong, and the command group at Tong Pass. Who could decide whether the army was to leave the pass, and whose word counted, was the real stake of this battle.
people: 這場戰爭的關鍵人物集中在關門內外。哥舒翰是突騎施哥舒部出身的名將，天寶年間以隴右、河西節度使之任屢破吐蕃，攻石堡城而成名；755年他患風疾半身不遂，退居長安，及封常清、高仙芝相繼敗亡，才被拜為天下兵馬副元帥赴潼關。軍中文書田丘良代攝戎政，陣中大將王思禮與李承光爭權，軍令從此多歧。宰相楊國忠與哥舒翰互相忌懼：哥舒翰偽造安祿山手書構陷安思順，逼死安思順及其弟安元貞，又誅楊國忠所遣的杜乾運，楊國忠由此懼怕其握兵自重，屢請出關收復陝、洛。玄宗最初採納哥舒翰「堅守不出」的建議，郭子儀、李光弼亦自遠方上書力勸，玄宗卻一再遣使催戰，哥舒翰終於痛哭出關。叛軍方面，安祿山遣崔乾祐守陝郡，崔乾祐以示弱之姿誘敵，戰後又引叛軍攻潼關，並由火拔歸仁等將領將哥舒翰縛送洛陽。安慶緒在河北坐鎮，行事風格與其父截然不同。哥舒翰被囚禁後曾寫信勸降諸將，反為同袍所辱；安慶緒退保鄴城前，將他與程千里等三十餘名俘虜一併殺害。
peopleEn: The decisive figures of this battle stand on both sides of the pass. Geshu Han was a famous general descended from the Geshu tribe of the Tujue, who had won repeated victories over the Tibetans as military governor of Longyou and Hexi and had become known through the storming of Shibao fortress. In 755 he was struck by a paralytic illness that left half his body useless and he retired to Chang'an; only after Feng Changqing and Gao Xianzhi were defeated and then slandered to death was he appointed deputy commander-in-chief and sent to hold Tong Pass. The paperwork of the army passed to the civilian officer Tian Qiuliang, and rival commanders Wang Sili and Li Chenguang quarrelled over authority, so that orders from that moment on ran in several directions at once. Chancellor Yang Guozhong both suspected and feared Geshu Han: the general had forged a letter attributed to An Lushan to implicate An Sishun, had driven An Sishun and his brother An Yuanzhen to their deaths, and had executed Du Qianyun, Yang's own appointee. Terrorised at the thought of such a mass of troops in one pair of hands, Yang repeatedly petitioned for the army to leave the pass and retake Shaan and Luo. Xuanzong at first accepted Geshu Han's advice to hold firm behind the walls; Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi also sent letters from the east urging the same. Yet the emperor kept sending envoys to demand an offensive, and in the end Geshu Han left the pass in tears. On the rebel side, An Lushan had posted Cui Qianyou at Shaan Commandery, where the man feigned weakness to draw the Tang out; after the battle he led the rebels against Tong Pass, and generals such as Huoba Guiren turned against their commander and had Geshu Han bound and carried off to Luoyang. An Qingxu sat in the north as his father's opposite number, and the way he handled things was nothing like the way his father had handled things. Imprisoned after his capture, Geshu Han wrote to the Tang commanders urging them to surrender and was mocked by them for it; before An Qingxu abandoned Chang'an for Ye, he had the general killed together with Cheng Qianli and more than thirty other prisoners.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬方陣盾（scutum），是公元前一世紀末羅馬共和國步兵的標準防具：凸面的長方盾，邊緣相扣，盾牆連成一線，靠的是盾緣咬住盾緣，而不是盾體本身的厚度；它配套的是短劍、投槍與披掛重甲的步兵，用來硬吃騎兵衝鋒。靈寶的唐軍並沒有這套裝備，唐軍步卒用的是明光鎧、長槊與步弩，兩軍在形制上相隔近八百年，讀卡時要分清：羅馬方陣盾在這場戰爭裡的位置是「觀念上的位置」，不是「編制上的位置」。真正上陣的是別的東西。唐軍一方有裝備齊整的龍武軍精騎、推鋒陷陣的陌刀手，以及以拒馬槊布成步陣的長槊兵；叛軍一側同樣有五千陌刀手列在陣後，以契丹、奚、靺靼輕騎擔任迂迴與追擊，靠的是速度而不是護甲。攻城與運輸方面，叛軍備有雲梯、撞車一類攻城具，卻因潼關南倚山壁、北臨黃河而無從展開，只能改走險隘；唐軍則靠黃河上數百艘運糧船維持關中儲糧，大軍糧秣另有隴右、河東、劍南三路輸送。最刺眼的一幕發生在潰敗之時：官軍爭相上船，糧船因為超載而沉沒，有人把矛綁在盾上充作渡河的浮具。同一件盾牌，在羅馬是結陣的壁，在靈寶卻只剩一塊木板——這正是全場最能見出裝備與制度落差之處。
kitsEn: The card's Roman scutum was the standard piece of protection of the Roman republican infantry in the late first century BC: a convex rectangular shield whose rim interlocked with its neighbour, so that a line of shields held together not by the thickness of the shield itself but by rim biting rim, and it was used together with the short sword, the throwing spear and the heavily equipped foot soldier, to absorb the charge of cavalry. The Tang army at Lingbao had no such equipment at all: its infantry used polished plate armour, long spears and crossbows, and the two systems of arms were separated by close to eight hundred years in date, so the distinction has to be kept clear when reading the card. The scutum's place in this battle is a place in the idea, not a place on the establishment roll. What actually fought here were other things. On the Tang side there were the well-equipped elite cavalry of the Longwu Army, the sword-in-hand infantry of the dadao, and spearmen who formed a bristling foot line with their long lances; on the rebel side there were likewise five thousand dadao men drawn up at the rear of the line, while Khitan, Xi and Mohe light horse carried out the turning movement and the pursuit, relying on speed rather than on armour. For siege and transport the rebels brought scaling ladders, battering rams and the like, but because Tong Pass has the mountains to its south and the Yellow River to its north there was no room to work them, and they were forced to take the dangerous track instead; the Tang, for their part, kept the granaries of Guanzhong stocked with several hundred grain-carrying boats on the river, while the army's supplies came by three other routes, from Longyou, Hedong and Jiannan. The most striking scene took place during the rout: the soldiers of the defeated army clambered into the boats, the grain ships sank under the weight of the men who crowded into them, and some of the fugitives tied their spears to their shields and used the shields as floats to cross the river. The same shield that was a wall in Rome had been reduced to a board of wood at Lingbao, and this is where the gap in equipment and in institutions shows most plainly.
tactics: 整場戰役是典型的一場「縱隊送死」：叛軍先把唐軍引出潼關，再在狹隘地形裡吃掉它的前鋒。崔乾祐守陝郡時故意放倒旗子、停止擊鼓，裝出沒有防備的模樣；玄宗徵詢哥舒翰，翰答以安祿山蓄謀已久必有防備，上計是王師堅守、待其內變。郭子儀與李光弼自河東、朔方上書同聲力勸，玄宗不聽，一再派中使催促，哥舒翰終於痛哭出關。出關以後的編制是：哥舒翰乘船在黃河上望見敵軍兵少，誤判其虛實，命大軍冒進；主力分作數段，王思禮率精銳當先鋒，另有三萬人沿河岸鳴鼓造勢，其餘十萬人隨後跟進。全軍擠入靈寶西南那道南北夾峙、長約七十里的山道，行列拉長，進退不成行列；叛軍在高處擲石，官兵於是先傷。接戰之後，崔乾祐的隊伍以什伍為最小單位，一進一退輪番消耗，末尾才推出五千陌刀手；唐軍見其陣形雜亂，伸手指點嘲笑，隊伍遂懈，敵軍突然貼身死鬥，短兵相接之下長槊長刀盡失所效。哥舒翰下令以毛皮氈帳蒙住馬車，想推車向北突圍，叛軍卻以柴薪塞道、順風縱火，濃煙之中官軍自相殘殺；其餘的人拋盔棄甲奔向山谷，泅水者溺斃於河，爭上運糧船者把船壓沉，潰兵一路自相踐踏直抵潼關。潼關門前早挖有三道壕溝，黑夜之中看不分明，屍體把壕溝填滿。
tacticsEn: The whole engagement was a classic case of a column walking into a slaughter: the rebels first drew the Tang army out of Tong Pass, and then ate its vanguard in the narrow ground behind it. Holding Shaan Commandery, Cui Qianyou deliberately lowered his flags and stopped the drums so as to look unprepared; when Xuanzong consulted Geshu Han, the general answered that An Lushan had plotted for a long time and must be prepared, that the best plan was for the imperial army to hold the pass and wait for the enemy to split, and Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi wrote from Hedong and Shuofang to say the same. The emperor would not listen, and kept sending envoys to press for the attack, until Geshu Han left the pass in tears. The order of march after the army came out was this: Geshu Han went up in a boat on the Yellow River, saw that the enemy force was small, misread the situation and ordered the army forward; the host was then broken into several parts, with Wang Sili leading the elite cavalry as vanguard, some 30,000 men beating drums along the riverbank to make a show, and the remaining 100,000 following behind. The whole army was squeezed into the narrow track south-west of Lingbao, hemmed in between mountain and river and some seventy li long; the columns stretched out, the ranks could neither advance nor form, and the rebels dropped stones from the heights, killing and wounding the troops before a single blow was struck. When the fighting did begin, Cui Qianyou's troops fought in units of ten and five, advancing and withdrawing in turn to wear the Tang down, and only at the end did they bring forward their five thousand men with the dadao. The Tang soldiers, seeing such a disordered array, pointed at it and laughed, and the formation slackened; then the enemy came on desperately in close combat, and at that range the long lances and long swords could no longer be made to work. Geshu Han ordered the carts to be covered over with felt tents, meaning to push north through the breach, but the rebels blocked the road with firewood and fired it with the wind behind it; in the smoke the Tang soldiers killed one another, and those who could threw away helmet and armour and ran for the gullies, those who swam were drowned in the river, and those who crowded into the grain boats sank them, the routed men trampling one another all the way to Tong Pass. Three ditches had been dug in front of the gate, and in the dark men could not see them; the ditches were filled with the dead.
data: 關於兵力的記載彼此打架，可以一併看：《舊唐書·哥舒翰傳》說他「二十萬眾拒賊關門」，《舊唐書》本紀卻作「哥舒翰將兵八萬」，《劍橋中國史》所引的現代估計則是十四萬三千人。比較可靠的是《資治通鑑》與《舊唐書》保存下來的戰鬥過程中的數字：哥舒翰在三萬人鳴鼓、王思禮率精銳當先鋒之外，還有十萬人跟在後面；崔乾祐的陣後列有五千陌刀手。距離方面，靈寶縣南倚山壁、北臨黃河，中間是長約七十里的狹窄山道，潼關就在這條通道的西端，兩地之間靠桃林塞的驛道相連。損失方面，朝廷只收攏到數百名騎兵渡河回關，老弱殘兵不足八千；南宋謝采伯《密齋筆記》概括為「潼關喪師二十萬，僅存八千」。潼關門前的三道壕溝被屍體填滿，黃河上數百艘運糧船因逃難官兵爭相登船而沉沒——這兩筆是全場最詳細的傷亡與損失記載。時間線上，天寶十五載六月出關與敗績，七月長安淪陷、玄宗西幸；至德二載九月安祿山被安慶緒所殺，九月二十八日唐軍進攻長安，十月十六日安慶緒逃往鄴城，走前殺害哥舒翰等三十餘名俘虜。
dataEn: The records of the size of the armies contradict one another, and it is worth setting them side by side. The biography of Geshu Han in the Old Book of Tang says that he met the rebels at the pass with 'two hundred thousand men'; the annals of the same work say instead that 'Geshu Han led eighty thousand men'; and the modern estimate quoted in The Cambridge History of China gives 143,000. More reliable are the figures embedded in the course of the battle as preserved in the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid to Government and in the Old Book of Tang: besides the 30,000 beating drums and Wang Sili's elite cavalry in the vanguard, another 100,000 men followed behind, and five thousand men with the dadao were drawn up at the rear of Cui Qianyou's line. As to distance, the district of Lingbao has the mountain wall to its south and the Yellow River to its north, with a narrow track some seventy li long between them, and Tong Pass stands at the western end of that track, the two places joined by the post road through Taolin. As to losses, the court managed to bring back only several hundred horsemen who crossed the river, and the old and sick left alive came to fewer than eight thousand; Xie Caibo's Notes from a Sealed Chamber in the Southern Song summed it up as 'the pass at Tong lost two hundred thousand men, and only eight thousand remained.' The three ditches in front of the gate were filled with the dead, and several hundred grain-carrying boats on the river sank because the fleeing soldiers crowded into them — these are the most detailed casualty and loss records the battle leaves us. On the timeline: the army left the pass and was beaten in the sixth month of the fifteenth year of Tianbao; Chang'an fell and the emperor went west in the seventh month; in the ninth month of the second year of Zhide An Lushan was killed by An Qingxu, the Tang army attacked Chang'an on the twenty-eighth, and on the sixteenth of the tenth month An Qingxu fled to the city of Ye, killing Geshu Han and more than thirty other prisoners on the way out.
cause: 直接導火線在關外：755年安祿山自范陽起兵，河北、河南望風披靡，叛軍攻入洛陽，兵鋒直指潼關。潼關是關中的門戶，東面出關便是陝、洛與中原，唐廷若失此關，長安與關中糧倉便全部暴露。朝廷先後起用封常清、高仙芝兵敗退保，兩人被讒殺，於是把風疾半身不遂、臥病在家的哥舒翰推出來當天下兵馬副元帥，讓這位隴右宿將去守最要緊的一關。哥舒翰初到潼關便主張「賊方銳，避其鋒以待援」，與前任們的判斷一致，二十萬大軍據關不出，潼關本身也確實難攻。可是朝廷內部的權力鬥爭把戰略壓了下去：楊國忠既與安思順結怨又懼怕哥舒翰兵權過重，杜乾運屯兵霸上、誅殺之事接連發生，玄宗又中了崔乾祐示弱之計，屢遣中使催戰。真正的起因有三層：安史叛亂本身的既定步驟、朝廷主戰與避戰之間的方針之爭，以及把一場本該守的仗打成必須進攻的體制性失誤。
causeEn: The immediate spark lay beyond the pass. In 755 An Lushan raised troops at Fanyang, and Hebei and Henan fell to him as word spread; the rebels took Luoyang and their spearhead pointed straight at Tong Pass. Tong Pass was the gate of Guanzhong: step out of it eastward and there lie Shaan, Luo and the Central Plain, and if the court lost it then Chang'an and the granaries of Guanzhong would all be exposed. The court first used Feng Changqing and Gao Xianzhi, who were beaten back and then slandered to death, and so it pushed Geshu Han, the general who was himself laid low by a paralytic illness and bedridden at home, into the post of deputy commander-in-chief, to hold the single most important pass. On arriving at Tong Pass, Geshu Han held that the enemy was fresh and that the right course was to avoid their edge and wait for reinforcements — the same judgement as his predecessors — and with 200,000 men he stayed behind the walls; Tong Pass itself was genuinely hard to take. But the struggle for power inside the court pressed the strategy down. Yang Guozhong bore a grudge against An Sishun and feared the weight of troops in Geshu Han's hands; the posting of Du Qianyun to Baishang and the man's execution followed one another; and the emperor, taken in by Cui Qianyou's show of weakness, sent envoys again and again to press for a battle. There are really three layers of cause here: the fixed stages of the An Lushan revolt itself, the quarrel between the war party and the wait-and-see party at court, and finally a structural misjudgement that turned a battle which ought to have been defended into one that had to be attacked.
impact: 靈寶之戰是唐王朝由盛轉衰的一道分水嶺。潼關與長安在半年之內相繼淪陷，玄宗西幸蜀中，途中馬嵬兵變，楊國忠被軍士殺於亂軍之中；太子李亨北上靈武即位為肅宗，中樞自此分為兩套，討賊的大義名分與父子之間的怨疑糾纏在一起，讓此後的平叛從頭到尾夾在政治算計與戰場勝負之間。轉折之中也埋著反轉：叛軍雖一度據有長安，卻無法鞏固關中，河北老巢反而被郭子儀、李光弼從常山、河東方向收復，兩京在至德二載相繼光復，安慶緒退保鄴城，戰局翻回唐軍這一邊。真正的代價留在西北與制度兩處：潼關抽空二十萬大軍入中原，河西隴右的邊防隨之空虛，吐蕃趁勢攻入鄯、廓一帶，涼州亦在數年後淪陷；而在中原，潼關這種咽喉要地的失守，暴露的是朝廷無法統攏各鎮節度使、只能靠將帥私人威望維持的體制弱點，安史之亂平定之後，藩鎮權力再未收回到中央，此後唐廷長期陷入藩鎮割據與宦官專權的循環。戰術層面上，這場敗仗也留下了一份反面教材：以縱隊深入隘道、指望靠奇襲與快戰取勝，等於把前鋒送進對方預設的殺場；潼關失守之後，官軍轉而改守城、固根本，先保睢陽、泗州一線的江淮漕運，再圖反攻，一守一攻之間才慢慢把主動權拿了回來。
impactEn: The Battle of Lingbao was the watershed at which the Tang dynasty turned from strength to decline. Tong Pass and Chang'an fell within half a year of each other, the emperor went west to Shu, and on the way the mutiny at Mawei ended with Yang Guozhong killed by his own soldiers; the crown prince Li Heng rode north to Lingwu and took the throne as Suzong, and from that point the court split in two, with the righteous cause of suppressing the rebels entangled with the suspicion between father and son, so that the rest of the war was fought between political calculation and the plain fact of battle. There was a reversal buried inside the reversal: the rebels held Chang'an for a time but could not make Guanzhong secure, while their old base in Hebei was taken back by Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi from Changshan and Hedong, and in the second year of Zhide the two capitals were recovered in turn, An Qingxu falling back on Ye and the tide turning back towards the Tang. The real price was paid in two places, in the northwest and in the institutions. The pass had drawn 200,000 men out of the northwest, and the frontier defences of Hexi and Longyou stood empty; the Tibetans took advantage and pushed into Shan and Guang, and Liangzhou fell some years later. In the central plain, the loss of a place like Tong Pass laid bare the structural weakness that allowed the court to hold the regional governors only through the personal prestige of individual commanders; once the An Lushan rebellion was over, the authority of the provincial military governors was never gathered back to the centre, and the Tang thereafter remained locked in a cycle of provincial separatism and eunuch dictatorship. At the level of tactics the defeat also left a cautionary example: pushing a column into a narrow track in the hope of a surprise and a quick decision is to feed the vanguard into a slaughter the enemy has already prepared. After Tong Pass was lost the government turned to holding cities and securing the base, first protecting the canal route through Suiyang and Si prefecture, and only then thinking of the counter-offensive, and it was in that alternation of holding and striking that the initiative slowly came back to the Tang.
result: 官軍在靈寶全線崩潰：王思禮所率精銳前鋒全數陷在山谷與蘆蒿之間，步卒多數潰散，哥舒翰只帶數百騎兵渡河回到潼關，關門前的三道壕溝被自己人的屍體填滿。潼關隨即失守，崔乾祐與火拔歸仁等將領反戈，將哥舒翰縛架送洛陽；安祿山以舊怨相譏，哥舒翰為免死而出仕燕國，被授司空、同中書門下平章事，卻只寫出勸降諸將的信，空有虛名而無一人肯從。安慶緒弒父自立之後，局勢急轉直下，至德二載十月十六日安慶緒放棄長安北走鄴城，臨行前將哥舒翰、程千里等三十餘名俘虜一併殺害，哥舒氏一門在唐的將門傳統自此斷了一支。對唐廷而言，靈寶之戰的直接結果是一道關門的失守、一支大軍的潰散與一次倉促西遷；對整場戰爭而言，結果卻是短暫的：叛軍沒有能夠把關中經營成根據地，而守成的一方在換了主帥、改了方針之後，靠著守住關隘與運道，一步一步把長安與洛陽拿了回來。最終的結局要再等兩年——史思明再度起兵，戰亂一直延到廣德元年（763）方告平息，而西北與中原的破口再也沒有完全補上。
resultEn: The Tang army collapsed completely at Lingbao: the elite cavalry vanguard under Wang Sili was swallowed up in the gullies and reed beds, the foot soldiers broke in mass, and Geshu Han brought back only several hundred horsemen across the river to the pass, the three ditches in front of the gate filled with the bodies of his own men. Tong Pass was lost at once. Cui Qianyou and generals such as Huoba Guiren turned their coats, and Geshu Han was bound and carried off to Luoyang. An Lushan mocked him over their old quarrel, and to save his life the general entered the service of Yan, being made司空 and chancellor in chief of the Yan court; all he could do was write letters urging the Tang commanders to surrender, and not one of them obeyed, so that his new rank was an empty one. After An Qingxu killed his father and seized power the situation turned swiftly against the rebels, and on the sixteenth of the tenth month of the second year of Zhide, as An Qingxu abandoned Chang'an and moved north to Ye, he had Geshu Han, Cheng Qianli and more than thirty other prisoners killed on the way; from that point the Geshu line of generals, one of the great military families of the Tang, was broken. For the court the immediate result of the Battle of Lingbao was the loss of a pass, the destruction of an army and a hurried flight to the west. For the war as a whole the result was merely temporary: the rebels never turned Guanzhong into a base, and the side that had chosen to hold, once it changed commanders and changed policy, took Chang'an and Luoyang back step by step by keeping the passes and the supply lines. The final reckoning came two years later, when Shi Siming rose in rebellion again and the fighting did not end until the first year of Guangde (763), and the breaches opened in the northwest and in the central plain were never fully closed.
